description: Defines a SwiftUI wrapper for a macOS visual effect view using NSVisualEffectView, allowing customization of material, blending mode, state, and emphasis.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the VisualEffectView with specified material, blending mode, state, and emphasis options.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSVisualEffectView instance based on the current properties.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates an existing NSVisualEffectView instance with the latest properties.
